title: Each eigenvalue's Jordan structure on the cut-open torus is the leading part of one moment matrix
subject: Networks of rings joined by shared contacts, read with the canonical knot test on their space-time law
conclusion: At sides 2^m each eigenvalue's Jordan blocks on the cut-open torus are the partial multiplicities of one explicit moment matrix, whose reduction to the eigenvectors has the leading part u⁻¹Y^k L(u²/Y) at every eigenvalue to side 256 (computed). Its leading matrix is invertible for every k (proved), so this is the whole chain lemma 2k − 1 − 4j; its bottom three orders are proved.
